title: Translation
description: A Wheel of Heaven Translation (the -woh book family) with machine-readable provenance: source text, glossary version, model versions used in drafting, reviewer, and divergences from the base translation. Returned by /v1/translations/{slug}/.

version.description: Semantic version of the translation as a whole.

sourceText.description: Human-readable label for the source-text edition translated from.

glossaryVersion.description: Semantic version of the glossary this translation conforms to.

divergencesFromBase.description: Notable lexical decisions diverging from a base translation, with gloss IDs.
